title: Wrapped Monero token crashes 99.8% amid suspected $13.5M exploit
summary: Bitquery traced $13.5 million in suspicious sales of the wrapped Monero token, as its operator blamed a security breach and promised to reimburse affected traders.

title: Sky Protocol sees $2 billion in stablecoin withdrawals, disputes illicit fund claims
summary: Sky says its USDS stablecoin held its $1 value despite more than $2 billion in withdrawals, as it disputes a report linking the protocol to illicit activity.

title: Bitcoin falls below $60K for first time since July amid broader market selloff
summary: Bitcoin fell nearly 6% as US stocks declined, with the Nasdaq dropping more than 2% and Anthropic shares losing almost 10%.

title: US Senate advances prediction market restrictions with DEATH BETS Act
summary: The Senate-approved bill would ban prediction market contracts tied to war, assassination and death amid concerns over potential insider trading on military events.

title: Bitcoin price drops to $60K as Anthropic drops to $87 in tech sell-off
summary: Bitcoin price strength felt pressure from falling US equities as traders reassessed AI prospects after Anthropic’s IPO.

title: DBS bets it can lose the deposit and keep the client
summary: The Singapore bank earned a record $208 million in transaction services fees in the third quarter — now it’s helping companies turn deposits into stablecoins they can spend without it.

title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

title: Lagarde warns Europe could miss chance to unify tokenized markets
summary: The ECB president said Europe’s market for tokenized securities could split into platforms that cannot settle trades with one another.

title: Binance hacker moves nearly $600M in ETH, routes funds through THORChain, Chainflip
summary: OnChain Lens tracked nearly $600 million in ETH transfers over two days as the Binance hackers moved the stolen funds through fresh wallets and cross-chain protocols to obscure their trail.

title: VanEck to end Gemini ETF custody deals, keeps Coinbase
summary: VanEck plans to end Gemini’s custody agreements for three crypto ETFs in February 2027, while Coinbase will continue serving as a custodian for the funds.
